import sys, os, json, time
import numpy as np

from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = '/app/output'

def obs(save='state'):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=True)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, f'{save}_{cam}.png'))

    return o

def pose(x,y,z,quat,grip=0,video='mp4'):
    arr=np.array([[x,y,z,*quat,float(grip)]],dtype=float)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',arr,video=video)
    print('MOVE', json.dumps(res.meta,default=str))
    if video=='mp4' and res.video:

            open(os.path.join(OUT,f'latest_{cam}.mp4'),'wb').write(b)

    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':

    now=o.meta['proprio']['now']; quat=now[11:15]
